entries.positive_observation: The yellow mascot retains green-ringed black eyes, spectacles, one serious mouth, the viewer-left pose, light jacket and dark closure. The distinct small right-edge tab, photographic frame/backplate and largely blank lower note remain.
entries.alpha_decision: Native RGBA is 2048x2048 with extrema 0..254. Counts are 0=2139445, 252=596051, 253=1349410, 254=240 and 255=0. White/cyan/alpha comparisons show no visible interior holes or lost photographic backing; internal 252-254 values are not rejection grounds. The visible generic mark-shape substitutions remain an RGB art defect, so this is not approved and no alpha-only substitution is claimed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine spectacles-rim detail, the exact central closure and readable note glyphs cannot be resolved at 65x67. Rejection relies on plainly visible oversized ovals, a wedge and repeated round dots rather than guessed text.
